fingerprint_rule: RFC8785/SHA-256 over the complete record after removing only the terminal fingerprint named by identity_excludes
persisted_bytes_rule: Every intent bytes_sha256 and byte_length names the exact UTF-8 persisted bytes: scalar JCS plus LF for intake values, complete record JCS plus LF for semantic records, normalized content JSON plus LF, or canonical YAML bytes exactly as declared by the runtime vectors.
semantic_state_rules: active_hold requires null result_ref, result_fingerprint, and retained_until_utc
retained_result requires non-null result_ref, result_fingerprint, and retained_until_utc
tombstone requires null result_ref, result_fingerprint, and retained_until_utc and is non-expiring
operation-context resolved_definitions are unique by definition_ref and sorted by UTF-8 exact_ref bytes
coverage_results are definition order; field_sources are target-pointer order and unique by target_pointer and coverage_id
transaction IDs reproduce the operation-discriminated preimage in the runtime contract
each operation has the exact ordered intent, stage, marker, evidence, result, and ledger mapping closed by the control schema
intent outputs and staged outputs use contiguous ordinal order and agree exactly in digest and length
marker and evidence authoritative/subordinate outputs agree exactly with the intent and installed semantic fingerprints

exact refs use lowercase dot-separated identity segments with no empty, doubled-hyphen, leading-hyphen, or trailing-hyphen segment; safe refs use nonempty slash-separated local segments with no absolute, dot, dot-dot, backslash, colon, empty, or oversized segment path
no raw idempotency key is persisted in any control record
domain results and internal evidence are not canonical Phase-4 WriteReceipt records

staging verification uses only the exact ordered staged/<ordinal>-<token>.bin refs; installed_complete verification uses only the exact ordered intent final refs, and both bases agree with intent digest and length
intake append samples one non-null finalized_at_utc in the durable intent and exact replay retains it; candidate append and promotion are timestamp-free and require sampled_finalized_at_utc null
operation-context resolved_definitions must equal their UTF-8 definition_ref-sorted projection before context fingerprint admission
operation context, coverage evaluation, all four runtime records, and all three transaction intents bind the same exact context_fingerprint

a new key is pre-establishment until repository identity, exact operation context, and deterministic evaluation produce either a closed commit plan or one establishedRefusal; pre-establishment failures create no ledger, journal, evidence, result, or artifact bytes

establishment atomically publishes exactly one fingerprint-valid intent at the recognized establishing path; active_hold is its exact logical projection before or after byte-preserving move to pending intent.json and is never separately persisted; an established refusal uses planned_outcome refuse, the identical closed refusal at every journal/result layer, zero artifact outputs, and non-null internal evidence

the only refusal journal prefixes are active_hold+intent, +verified refusal_decision, +refused marker, +evidence, +result, +retained_result ledger, and +committed rename; exact prefixes resume the missing suffix and every mismatch or non-prefix state refuses without mutation

an exact retained refused result replays byte-identically despite later context or artifact drift; same-key different request conflicts; its tombstone returns idempotency_expired for the exact request and idempotency_conflict for a different request
established refusal recovery never creates, replaces, adopts, deletes, or exposes canonical, semantic-record, or subordinate-closure output bytes

stale_basis repeats non-null unequal expected/observed basis fingerprints; stale_current_artifact repeats the exact nullable request expectation and locked nullable observation and requires them to differ; every other established refusal has both fingerprint fields null
promotion resolved_definitions equal the cited operation-context resolved_definitions byte-for-byte, including UTF-8 exact_ref order
every domain-result evidence ref uses the operation-discriminated transaction family and its identical transaction_id; no family alias is admitted

establishment crash states are only no file, non-authoritative .intent.writing, established .intent with no shell, established .intent with its exact empty pending shell, or pending intent.json with no establishing file; every transition preserves identical intent bytes and all dual, extra, nonempty-shell, retained/tombstone overlap, path, key, transaction, or fingerprint mismatch states refuse

negative_vectors.mutation: repeat a definition_ref with another fingerprint
repeat one field_sources target_pointer with another coverage_id
capitalize one exact-ref identity segment
use an empty hyphen component in an exact-ref identity segment
insert an empty path segment
insert a dot or dot-dot path segment
add idempotency_key to request, ledger, journal, result, or evidence
set active_hold result_ref/result_fingerprint
set retained_result retained_until_utc null
set tombstone result_ref
remove or add an operation-specific intent, marker, evidence, or result output
replace the required authoritative or subordinate class for one operation
pair an operation_id with another operation token or staged-output tuple
pair an operation with another atomic_group
start outputs at ordinal 1
change staged digest, byte length, or ordinal
change one marker ref, authority class, or fingerprint relative to intent
add condition, authority_class, atomic_group, or receipt_fingerprint to a domain result
place subordinate_closure in authoritative_outputs
set verification_basis installed_complete while retaining staged/<ordinal>-<token>.bin refs
set verification_basis staging while citing final installed refs
reorder two installed_complete final refs while retaining ordinals
replace one installed_complete final ref with another schema-valid content-addressed ref not named by intent
set intake append sampled_finalized_at_utc null
set candidate append sampled_finalized_at_utc to a date-time
set promotion sampled_finalized_at_utc to a date-time
change the durable intake sampled_finalized_at_utc during replay
move one resolved_definitions binding out of UTF-8 definition_ref order and recompute the terminal fingerprint
replace one coverage, runtime, or transaction-intent operation-context fingerprint with another valid SHA-256
persist any active_hold, intent, evidence, result, or output for a request rejected before exact context and deterministic operation evaluation complete
add an output descriptor, staged byte, authoritative output, or subordinate output to an established refusal
retain a refused result with null, absent, or mismatched internal evidence
change operation, transaction, request, context, intent, verified, marker, refusal, or evidence binding at any refusal prefix
pair a refusal code with a non-authorized layer or fingerprint nullability
use equal expected and observed fingerprints for stale_basis or stale_current_artifact
recover result without evidence, ledger without result, committed rename without ledger, or any other non-prefix refusal state
submit a different request under the active or retained refusal key
re-evaluate or change a retained refusal after operation-context or canonical-artifact drift
attempt to establish or re-evaluate the exact request after refused-result retention becomes a tombstone
submit a different request under the refused-result tombstone key
replace intake-records, artifact-candidates, or artifact-promotions in a committed or refused result evidence ref with another or shortened family
retain the right evidence family but change the transaction token or digest in the evidence ref
persist an active_hold ledger record as separate authority bytes rather than deriving it from the one established intent
create dual established/pending intent, nonempty shell, multiple scratch files, retained or tombstone overlap, or any path/key/transaction/fingerprint mismatch
